title: MGIT Conducts Successful Workshop on Entrepreneurship in Association with IIC, CDC, and EDC - MGIT
content:
## MGIT Conducts Successful Workshop on Entrepreneurship in Association with IIC, CDC, and EDC

News Date : 16 Feb 2023News ReportThe IIC MGIT, in collaboration with CDC MGIT and EDC MGIT, conducted an informative workshop on Entrepreneurship. The session featured a welcome address by Gousiya, a member of IIC, followed by Dr. G Chandramohan Reddy, the Principal, who shared valuable insights on entrepreneurship. Dr. V.V.N. Satya Suresh, the CDC Director, also provided words of advice to the students. The keynote speaker, Asim Akhtar, Deputy General Manager TIM E Institute, discussed the importance of entrepreneurship and the motivation behind it. He emphasized the value that entrepreneurs bring to the community and their role as problem solvers. The speaker also highlighted the necessary skill sets for entrepreneurs and engaged in an interactive session with the students. The session ended with the speaker encouraging the students to pursue their dreams and be passionate about what they aspire to do. Dr. Asheesh Singh, coordinator of IIC MGIT, extended the vote of thanks to everyone involved in the successful organization of the event, including the speakers, coordinators, and directors.
